description: This file defines an AuthenticationException class in PHP, extending the base Exception class, with various static factory methods for creating specific authentication-related exception instances, and a method to normalize exception details for external use.

classes.name: AuthenticationException
classes.description: Custom exception class for handling various authentication error cases in the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns an associative array with error details, including a translated message.

methods.name: employeeNotAssigned
methods.description: Creates an instance indicating that the employee is not assigned.

methods.name: employeeTerminated
methods.description: Creates an instance indicating that the employee is terminated.

methods.name: userDisabled
methods.description: Creates an instance indicating that the user account is disabled.

methods.name: invalidCredentials
methods.description: Creates an instance indicating invalid login credentials.

methods.name: invalidCsrfToken
methods.description: Creates an instance indicating CSRF token validation failure.

methods.name: invalidResetCode
methods.description: Creates an instance indicating an invalid password reset code.

methods.name: noUserFound
methods.description: Creates an instance indicating no user was found.

methods.name: multipleUserReturned
methods.description: Creates an instance indicating multiple users were returned when only one was expected.

methods.name: sessionExpired
methods.description: Creates an instance indicating the user session has expired.
